b.lede: Amazon has suffered a major setback in its plans to offer a viable Starlink rival, after 40 satellites destined for low earth orbit were destroyed in a failed rocket launch.
b.title: Amazon’s Starlink rival sees major setback after 40 satellites destroyed in rocket failure
